final: WITH cnt AS (SELECT p.player_id, COUNT(ma.player_id) AS n FROM player p LEFT JOIN manager_award ma ON ma.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY p.player_id), tot AS (SELECT SUM(n) AS total FROM cnt) SELECT cnt.player_id, cnt.n, CAST(cnt.n AS REAL) / tot.total AS frac FROM cnt, tot WHERE tot.total IS NOT NULL ORDER BY frac IS NULL, frac DESC LIMIT 10
